notes: Champion select tunables (champ-select). performance: hoverDebounceSeconds = how long a hover must settle before the 3D body starts streaming (0.12-0.2 feels instant without loading every tile the mouse crosses); bodyCacheSize = streamed bodies kept resident; backgroundCacheSize = painted scenes kept resident (pinned full resolution); previewPoolSize = spawned preview bodies kept hidden for instant revisits (counts the visible one); neighbourPreload = bodies preloaded either side of the hovered hero once it is on screen; crossFadeSeconds = scene and card-to-body crossfade.
